{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Corv.png]] |name=Corv |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[5 BBY]], [[Ferrix]]The events of "[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]," which includes the [[death]] of Corv on [[Ferrix]], take place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:AndorDate|here]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Security Bureau]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I'm going to ask you a question. I expect an honest answer. If I'm not sure it's the truth, I'll have to call back Dr. Gorst.|Corv interrogates Bix Caleen|{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}}} '''Corv''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[ISB Attendant|attendant]] on [[Lieutenant]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]]'s staff within the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]]. In [[5 BBY]], Corv and fellow [[Aide|Attendant]] [[Avril Heert]] picked up the disgraced [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|lawman]] [[Syril Karn]] to be interviewed by Meero regarding an [[Luthen Rael|individual]] he encountered that the [[supervisor]] dubbed "Axis." Corv was present when Karn was interviewed. When the Empire captured a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]], he looked into an [[Imperial masking unit]] that the [[pilot]] had used. Later, Corv went undercover on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] to [[spy]] on the former [[Andor household|residence]] of the fugitive [[thief]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], whose [[Parent|mother]], [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], still lived there. He observed Maarva's apparent decline and [[death]] from afar, reporting it to Meero and passing along what he knew about the upcoming Ferrixian [[funeral]] customs. The attendant further kept watch over the Andor household and those that entered but also interviewed the traumatized [[prisoner]] [[Bix Caleen]] on whether the rebel leader [[Anto Kreegyr]] was Axis, failing to confirm whether the two individuals were the same. After Meero arrived on Ferrix, intent on capturing Cassian at his [[Andor family|mother's]] [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]], she had Corv accompany her around [[Ferrix City]], and the pair had a meeting with [[Captain]] [[Vanis Tigo]] and Lieutenant [[Merzin Keysax]] about the upcoming funeral afterward. Corv continued watching the Andor residence again but joined the procession when Maarva's funeral began earlier than Tigo had permitted. He also received information on Cassian's whereabouts from his [[Information broker|informant]] [[Nurchi]], relaying it to Meero and Tigo. The attendant helped search for Cassian, soon scanning around the funeral crowd until the people began [[Ferrix Riot|rioting against]] Tigo's [[Ferrix garrison|forces]]. With the riot escalating, Corv made his way down an alleyway, but was followed and killed by the undercover [[waiter]] [[Cinta Kaz]]. ==Biography== ===Gathering information=== {{Quote|Just came in. They picked up a rebel pilot an hour ago.''"
"''From our target list?''"
"''No, random. But he's using a stolen Imperial masking unit.''"
"''One of ours?''"
"''Well, Corv is checking but…|Heert and Dedra Meero|{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}}} During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Proclamation of the New Order|successor]] state of the [[Galactic Republic]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Corv served in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] as an [[ISB Attendant|attendant]] for [[Lieutenant]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] of the [[Investigations]] branch.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' Like his superiors, he operated from the [[ISB Central Office]] on the [[capital]] [[planet]] of{{Databank|coruscant|Coruscant}} [[Coruscant]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} Meero had Corv and fellow [[Aide|Attendant]] [[Avril Heert]] go to the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] to retrieve disgraced [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]]. The [[supervisor]] wanted to interview the former [[Police officer|lawman]] about an [[Ambush on Ferrix|incident]] in which he was involved on the planet [[Ferrix]] in the [[Morlani system]],{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} during which he encountered the [[thief]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and an unknown male buyer of stolen Imperial [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit|equipment]], nicknamed "Axis," whom she believed was at the center of an organized [[Axis network|rebel network]]. Axis was in reality the revolutionary leader [[Luthen Rael]]. At the Bureau of Standards' [[Imperial Bureau of Standards Coruscant office|Coruscant office]], the resident staff supervisor [[Flob]] directed Corv and Heert to Karn. The pair then took their subject back to the ISB Central Office. [[File:Isb_interrogation_chamber.png|thumb|left|320px|Corv watched Karn's interview from outside the chamber.]] Karn was put in an [[ISB interrogation room|interrogation room]], where Meero interviewed him, with Corv and Heert watching from outside. When Karn revealed during the interrogation that he had been unable to read the report on the Ferrix incident before being dismissed from his job in the Morlani [[Star system|system]], the supervisor and Heert had to leave to attend another meeting elsewhere in the building. As the pair left, Meero ordered Corv to give Karn a copy of the report to read. After Corv's colleagues returned, the attendant watched as Meero further questioned Karn about Axis before dismissing him. As Corv and Heert made their way toward the [[Blast door|door]], Karn began pleading to help the supervisor find Andor and Axis, only to be told to stay out of the ISB's way. Meero left Corv to see her subject out. On Ferrix, Meero interrogated [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]], a suspect who had kept communications with Axis and connected him with Andor, with the help of the interrogator [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]]. After a [[torture]]d Caleen gave up what she knew about the two individuals of interest, the supervisor, accompanied by Heert and Corv, attended an [[ISB Board]] meeting and gave her findings to [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]] and her fellow supervisors. Sometime later, the Empire captured a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]], having caught them using a stolen [[Imperial masking unit]]. While Heert sent Gorst to get the [[pilot]] talking, Corv checked whether the masking unit was stolen from Meero's jurisdiction and found that the device had been [[Theft at Lozash|stolen]] from a [[Lozash naval yard|naval yard]] in [[Lozash]], information which was passed on to the ISB Board by Heert. ===Undercover Ferrixian=== ====Surveillance==== {{Quote|Looks like someone died.''"
"''It happens.''"
"''Someone you know?''"
"''Just started last week.|Corv and Cinta Kaz discuss Maarva Andor's death|}} [[File:Corv-undercover-OWO.png|thumb|right|320px|An undercover Corv speaks with a Ferrixian.]] Afterward, Corv was sent undercover in Ferrix's [[Ferrix City|town]] to [[spy]] on [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], Cassian's [[Parent|mother]], who was growing weaker. Dressed in civilian [[clothing]], a local pointed him toward the [[Andor household]], and he watched as Maarva's friend [[Jezzi]] brought Doctor [[Mullmoy]] to the residence to help the elderly woman.{{Andor|One Way Out}} Corv also used the [[junk dealer]]{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} [[Nurchi]] as an inside man, for he was familiar with Cassian and some of those acquainted with him. Maarva soon [[Death|passed away]] and was taken out of the Andor household and past some civilians paying their respects in the street. Corv watched Maarva be taken out of her residence from [[Nicola's]], a cafe across the street. As the [[waiter]] [[Cinta Kaz]] came in with dirty cups, the undercover attendant acknowledged the apparent death, asking her if she knew the person who had passed. Kaz replied that she had only started the [[Standard week|week]] before. She was in fact also undercover, working for Axis's rebel network and tasked with killing Cassian. ====Opportunities==== {{Quote|The dead are bricked. They mix your ashes with mortar and local stone dust, put your name on and fire it up. You become a block of Ferrix brick.''"
"''And then what?''"
"''They find you a wall.|Corv tells Dedra Meero about Ferrix's funeral traditions|}} [[File:Tigo-Keysax-Corv-DoF.png|thumb|left|320px|Corv updates Dedra Meero, accompanied by Captain Vanis Tigo and Lieutenant Keysax.]] After learning about the Ferrixian funeral traditions, Corv reported to the Imperial headquarters on Ferrix, a [[Hotel Rix|former hotel]]. Along with [[Captain]] [[Vanis Tigo]]—the Imperial [[Prefect (Galactic Empire)|prefect]] on the world—and Lieutenant [[Merzin Keysax]], the attendant contacted Meero, informing her of Maarva's passing. Tigo added that her status among the locals meant the [[City|town]] would want to hold a public [[funeral]] for her. Meero ordered that they allow the funeral with reduced numbers and timings, intent on it being an opportunity to lure out Cassian. On Meero's end, Heert asked how long it would be until the funeral, and Corv replied that two [[Standard day|days]] was the custom on Ferrix. The latter attendant further explained that, per tradition, Maarva's ashes would be used in to make an [[Funerary stone|engraved brick]] that would be added to a wall in her memory. Later, Corv sat at the cafe again, watching the [[Grappler (profession)|grappler]] [[Brasso]] enter the Andor household. Knowing Brasso as the "big man," the attendant gave orders over his [[comlink]] for his spotters to be in the front and back of the residence, giving full coverage and reporting any comings and goings to the building. That night, he had Caleen brought in for another interrogation, the [[prisoner]] still traumatized from previously being tortured by Doctor Gorst. At a [[holotable]], Corv showed her an image of the rebel leader [[Anto Kreegyr]], questioning whether the rebel was Axis and threatening to bring Gorst back if he believed she was lying. Caleen broke down, and Corv was unable to connect Kreegyr as Axis. ====Preparing a trap==== {{Quote|I want to get changed, take a walk around town.''"
"''I'll pull an escort.''"
"''No need. Corv will take me.|Dedra Meero and Vanis Tigo|}} [[File:Briefing-RR.png|thumb|right|320px|Corv plans for the trap on Cassian Andor with Meero, Tigo and Keysax.]] Meero arrived at the Ferrixian town in preparation for her plan to intercept Cassian at the funeral. At the Imperial headquarters, Corv met with the supervisor, who planned to be walked around the town in civilian clothing with her attendant. After filling in Tigo on her plans, she began walking the busy streets with Corv. Unbeknownst to them, Kaz followed the pair, having established that they were affiliated with the Imperial Security Bureau. The next day, Corv, Meero, Tigo, and Keysax convened around a holotable that displayed the layout of the town. They discussed the plans they had set out for the funeral and moved to a balcony to give the supervisor an in-person view of [[Rix Road]], a major street where the funeral was to be held. When Tigo mentioned the involvement of the [[Daughters of Ferrix]]—a social club of which Maarva was a past [[president]]—in the upcoming funeral, Meero questioned what it was, Corv filling her in about the group's role. Later, Corv was positioned on a balcony near the Andor household with a cup of [[caf]].{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} Watching the house door open, he spotted the grappler [[Rashi]] come out with Maarva's [[droid]] [[B2EMO]] and realized it was not Brasso. The attendant immediately took to his comm and informed the guard on the other side that they had been played, rhetorically questioning where the "big guy" was. ====Unpredicted changes==== {{Quote|Double the reward.''"
"''You found him?''"
"''I want twice as much and a ride out of here when it's over.''"
"''Where is he?''"
"''Pretend you're arresting me.|Nurchi and Corv|}} [[File:Nurchi-rats-RR.png|thumb|left|320px|Corv meets with Nurchi.]] Contrary to the timings the Empire had permitted, the town's "[[Time Grappler]]" sounded the start of [[Maarva's funeral procession]] at midday. A marching [[band]] began to walk down the streets playing their instruments. As civilians followed the band, Corv joined the growing procession as they walked down the street, sweeping his gaze around. Kaz once again tailed the undercover attendant, keeping further back in the group. As he moved swiftly through the crowd, Nurchi joined Corv, demanding his reward be doubled, and a ride out of town be arranged for him. The attendant asked if the junk dealer had found Cassian, his [[Information broker|informant]] responded by asking to be arrested as a bluff. Corv did so, manhandling Nurchi into a [[trooper]] checkpoint and taking him to the Imperial headquarters. Inside the headquarters, Nurchi informed the Imperials that Cassian was in a building across the street from the former [[hotel]], with Corv pointing it out to Tigo and Meero. The attendant then accompanied the supervisor to an entrance to the building in question, where two of Meero's [[death trooper]]s moved inside first, securing the bottom of a ladder. Corv then climbed the ladder, drawing a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]], but he found the top room empty. Meanwhile, the marching band formed in a circle in Rix Road's [[Fountain Square]], hundreds of Ferrixian civilians gathering around them and [[Imperial security trooper]]s forming a [[blockade]] of the road before it reached the Imperial headquarters. ====Plan gone awry==== {{Quote|You. What are you doing here?|Corv's last words, in confronting Cinta Kaz|}} After parting with Meero, Corv continued searching for Andor, scanning his [[eye]]s up at the buildings for any sign of him while he pushed through the funeral crowd. B2EMO showed a [[hologram]] in the middle of the circle of Maarva's final message to the Ferrixians, which condemned the Empire's [[Ferrix occupation|occupation of Ferrix]] and called on the residents to start fighting back. Tigo intervened and pushed the droid over, leading to a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] breaking out. While the aggravated crowd initially failed to break the blockade of security troopers, one of them, [[Wilmon Paak]], threw a [[pipe bomb]] at the Imperials, which exploded behind the blockade and set off a box of [[C-25 fragmentation grenade]]s, lining Rix Road with explosions. [[File:Corv-Kaz-RR.png|thumb|right|320px|Corv confronts Cinta Kaz.]] With both sides shaken by the [[bomb]]ing, Tigo ordered his [[stormtrooper]]s to open fire on the Ferrixians as the riot resumed. Corv went down an alleyway, with Kaz once again following him. This time, the undercover attendant noticed his stalker and questioned what she was doing there. As he moved to corner the woman in an alcove doorway, she drove a [[knife]] into his chest. Looking down in shock, Corv collapsed against the wall, and Kaz thrust the knife into his rib cage before removing it. The attendant dropped dead on the floor, and the rival spy closed the door on his body as she fled the scene. Kaz returned to her apartment, preparing to leave with her partner and accomplice, [[Vel Sartha]]. Upon returning to the room, Sartha noticed Corv's [[blood]] on Kaz's hands, believing her partner was bleeding until Kaz clarified it was not hers. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|That name, this face, have a good look. Is this the man you introduced to Cassian Andor?|Corv questions Bix Caleen|}} Corv had [[Color|light]] skin, black [[hair]], and brown eyes. While in his [[Imperial officer's uniform|Imperial uniform]], he frequently stood neutrally at ease while awaiting direction from his superiors. Undercover on Ferrix, he maintained full surveillance on the Andor household and its regular visitors, giving reports over his comlink on visits from Brasso and locking his eyes{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{AD|Disney+}} briefly on unknowing passersby. When a different grappler to Brasso appeared from the residence at one point, he sternly ordered for the "big guy" to be located. [[File:Corv-Bix-DoF.png|thumb|left|320px|Corv crouches beside the prisoner Bix Caleen as he interviews her.]] Corv was also sure to keep up with the Ferrixian traditions and social spheres, which he relayed to his cohorts as context when needed. In interviewing the traumatized Bix Caleen, Corv made clear his expectations of her and threatened further torture from Doctor Gorst if he did not believe he was getting an honest answer. He also crouched by the prisoner when he asked her questions, tightening his jaw when the captive broke down instead. In noticing that Kaz was following him during the Rix Road riot, Corv confronted her with a calm but threatening tone, only to look in shock when she fatally stabbed him. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Give him Blevin's report, let him read it. Keep him in there.|Dedra Meero, to Corv, on Syril Karn|}} [[File:Corv-drawn-RR.png|thumb|right|300px|Corv in civilian clothing with his DL-44 heavy blaster pistol drawn]] Corv wore a gray Imperial officer's uniform with black breeches, two [[code cylinder]]s, and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with two blue tiles, as was standard for ISB attendants. He sometimes wore a black [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]]. While undercover as a civilian on Ferrix, the attendant donned gray clothing with a maroon [[scarf]] and a gray and green [[Jacket|coat]] on top. He also wore a green [[hat]], gray trousers, and [[boot]]s, and he used a comlink and a DL-44 [[heavy blaster pistol]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I remember when I was a 5 year old being completely mesmerised by Star Wars. It blew me away. It was the best escapism, my favourite film. And it was at that moment I decided I wanted to be an actor, to tell stories that transported you to other people's worlds. Internally and externally. I can finally say after all these years that one of my lifelong goals has finally been achieved.|Noof Ousellam|{{Instagram|username=noofousellam|url=CeER1Y9ItI7|name=[[Noof Ousellam]]|date=2022-05-07|archivefile=File:NoufCorv.png}}}} Corv first appeared in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} Prior to the episode's release, he was first depicted in the teaser trailer for the show released on [[May 27]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} His name was then given in a since deleted image asset release on Getty Images by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] on [[August 1]].{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/6vx5pwtjxz9w5wjk2f2zjkxf|text=Andor Promo Asset|author=[[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]]|date=2022-08-01|nobackup=1}} The character was portrayed by [[Noof Ousellam]]. To Ousellam, working in ''Star Wars'' had been one of his lifelong goals, as the films had inspired him from a young age to become an actor. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Corv|soundcat=Audio files of Corv}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} *{{Andor|One Way Out}} *{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} *{{SW|url=news/new-andor-trailer-premiere-date|text=New ''Andor'' Trailer Goes Big on Rebel Action, and Updated Premiere Details Revealed}} {{Po}} *''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]'' *{{SWYouTube|VOfBli5P7fs|Andor | Season 1 Recap | Streaming on Disney+ and Hulu|int=Andor Season 1 Recap}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-revisited-rewatch-season-1-arc-3|text=''Andor'' Revisited: One Way Out - Exploring the Third Arc of Season 1}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-revisited-rewatch-season-1-arc-4|text=''Andor'' Revisited: Small Acts of Rebellion - Exploring the Fourth Arc of Season 1}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/6vx5pwtjxz9w5wjk2f2zjkxf|text=Andor Promo Asset|author=[[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]]|date=2022-08-01|nobackup=1}} {{1stID|Corv}} {{Interlang |es=Corv |fr=Corv |ja=コーヴ |ka=კორვი |nl=Corv }} [[Category:Clerical workers and assistants]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Security Bureau personnel]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
